home.headline: The Full Real Estate Ecosystem
home.aboutText: Pixel & Property is a real estate group based in Estoril, Portugal. We combine premium media production, professional property management, and investment strategy to offer a truly integrated approach to the real estate market — for agents, developers, and investors who refuse to settle for ordinary.

hero.headline:
Your property's first showing happens online.
Make it unforgettable.

about.label: About us
about.title: The media studio that quality real estate deserves
about.text1: Pixel & Property Digital is a forward-thinking real estate media studio, built for agents and developers who market to the world. We combine professional HDR photography, cinematic video, drone footage, and cutting-edge AI technology to transform listings into compelling visual stories.
about.text2: Specialised in strategic social media content, for showcasing properties or building personal brands. With over 8 years of camera experience and 4 years of social media expertise.

services.title: Build Your Presence. Stand Out. Attract Attention.
services.subtitle: Discover the full potential of our services.

items.name: HDR Photography
items.desc: Professional interior and exterior photography. A blend of architectural and real estate photography that captures every detail of your property with precision and quality. Delivered within 24 hours.

items.name: Promotional Videos
items.desc: Short-form vertical videos, designed to dominate social media — Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook. Content that captures attention and drives results.

items.name: Cinematic Video
items.desc: The classic look with a modern touch. Full horizontal property tour videos with smooth camera movements and professional color grading. Delivered in 3 days.

items.name: Drone & Aerial Photography
items.desc: Aerial photography and video that reveal perspectives ground-level images can never capture — inside and outside the property.

items.name: AI Integration
items.desc: We transform empty properties into beautifully staged spaces and projects still under construction into photorealistic final visualisations. The future of your property, visible today.

items.name: Social Media Management
items.desc: We handle the strategy, posting, and scheduling of your property content on social media — so you can stay focused on what really matters: the sale.

steps.name: Book
steps.desc: Contact us via WhatsApp, email, or book directly. We confirm within 24 hours.

steps.name: Shoot
steps.desc: We arrive ready. Photography, video, drone — everything captured in a single 1–2 hour visit.

steps.name: Edit
steps.desc: Professional color grading, AI enhancements, virtual staging, and video editing.

steps.name: Deliver
steps.desc: Photos in 48h. Cinematic videos in 3 days. Social media content in 10 days.

items.q: What's included in a standard shoot?
items.a: Every shoot includes 25+ HDR photos, a cinematic horizontal video (2–3 min), a vertical social media video (30–60 sec), drone footage, and professional editing. AI services available as an add-on.
Photos: 48 hours. Cinematic videos: 3 days. Social media videos: 10 days. AI services within 24–48 hours. Rush delivery available.
We serve properties across all of Portugal — Lisbon, Cascais, Estoril, Porto, Algarve, Comporta, and the Silver Coast. Travel included within 50km of Estoril.

items.q: Do you work in English and Portuguese?
items.a: Yes. Pixel & Property operates fully in both English and Portuguese. Website, communication, and deliverables are available in both languages.

pillars.title: Total peace of mind
pillars.desc: We handle everything — tenants, maintenance, documentation and payments. Landlords receive detailed monthly reports with zero hassle.

pillars.title: Maximised returns
pillars.desc: Dynamic pricing strategy, rigorous tenant selection and maximised occupancy. Your property works for you — even when you're on the other side of the world.

pillars.title: Premium experience
pillars.desc: Every interaction — with owners and tenants alike — is handled with professionalism and attention to detail. Because service quality reflects property value.

about.label: About us
about.text1: Pixel & Property Management was born from a real gap we identified in the market: property owners with valuable assets who lacked access to truly professional, transparent and dedicated management.
about.text2: Based in Estoril, we serve domestic and international property owners across all of Portugal. With a bilingual approach and a digital reporting system, owners always maintain full control — effortlessly.

items.name: Rental Management
items.desc: Rigorous tenant selection and screening, contracts, rent collection, deposit management and renewals. All handled with legal compliance and full transparency.

items.name: Maintenance & Repairs
items.desc: A trusted network of technicians and service providers. Fast emergency response, preventive maintenance and works supervision — without any owner intervention required.

items.name: Reporting & Transparency
items.desc: Detailed monthly reports covering income, expenses, occupancy and property condition. Permanent digital access to your property's complete history.

items.name: Legal & Tax Management
items.desc: Legal oversight of tenancy, compliance with Portuguese legislation, income declaration support and mandatory documentation management.

items.name: International Owners
items.desc: Fully bilingual service for non-resident owners. Communication in English and Portuguese, adapted to your timezone and the needs of remote property management.

items.name: Property Preparation
items.desc: Home staging, professional cleaning, photography and video (in partnership with Pixel & Property Digital) to ensure your property is presented to the market in the best possible light.

how.label: How it works

steps.name: Free consultation
steps.desc: We analyse your property, the local market, and present a tailored proposal with no commitment.

steps.name: Onboarding

steps.name: Active management
steps.desc: Listing on platforms, tenant selection, contracts and daily management — all under our team's supervision.

steps.name: Monthly report
steps.desc: You receive a detailed report of everything that happened at your property. Full transparency, always.
